sampling: Cached semantic callback data and the actual adapter sample at command N, measured before solver step N. No extra native physics read.
scope: Bind existing recovery shape identities in every walking session. Preserve normal-launcher and historical defaults. This can change the prefix and therefore the later kick trajectory; no paired or causal comparison is claimed.
timeout_rule: Report the actual native next-memory counters separately. A nonzero counter cannot be described as no timeouts. Do not replace the frozen evaluator flag or regrade historical results.
